summary: search_library returns rows whose chart blobs are 404 in both Storage and Drive, but with status:'active'
repro: search_library({query:'Shalom Rav'}) returns d22779d6-... as active; add_track_to_setlist({songId:d22779d6-...}) succeeds and bonds; verify_setlist_charts then reports {status:'missing', reason:'Not in Storage; Drive 404: File not found: d22779d6-...'}. Same pattern for Hashkiveinu cf704b73-... and Modeh Ani 2fc76c49-...
observed: Catalog rows with UUID-shaped songIds are returned as active by search_library but their underlying chart bytes don't exist in Storage or Drive. A band_leader trusting search_library will silently produce broken setlists; breakage only surfaces at publish-preflight or gig-packet time.
expected: search_library should default-hide rows whose chart bytes are confirmed missing, OR catalog rows with broken bonds should be flagged status:'orphaned' so the existing default-hide kicks in.

summary: swap_chart default syncMetadata:true clobbers hand-curated row titles
repro: Row title was custom 'Modeh ani - Keira' (NOT matching old song's catalog title 'Modeh ani - Klepper'). swap_chart({newSongId:'2fc76c49-...',  default syncMetadata}) replaced the title with the new catalog title 'Modeh Ani (Klepper-Freelander)'. NOTE-1 fallback either didn't trigger or fired on a substring match.
observed: A band_leader doing a routine chart-version swap loses personalized titles like Vocal Lead names attached to row titles.
expected: Either flip the default to syncMetadata:false, or make the NOTE-1 'is this the OLD catalog title' check stricter so non-matching custom titles are preserved.

summary: Admin-bearer cowork sweeps cannot use prefix cleanup; fixtures get owned by admin uid AND clone_setlist doesn't carry isTest:true → fixtures leak to public /perform listing
repro: clone_setlist via admin bearer → ownerId:'93Xn3DbS0bSNb8zmfzLyfOMX1A13' (Daniel's real uid). cleanup_all_test_data({prefix:'c9i2'}) → {removed:0}. CROSS-INSTANCE CORROBORATION: instance-1's C9I1-008 saw my c9i2-CLONE-emor-weekly-flow-test (eventDate 2030-01-04, 0 songs in their DOM observation) on the public /perform listing DURING this sweep — confirming clone_setlist does NOT carry isTest:true and the writer's name-heuristic in create_setlist does NOT match c9iN-CLONE- prefix.
observed: Three compounding gaps: (1) admin-owned fixtures aren't reachable via cleanup_all_test_data({prefix}), (2) clone_setlist has no isTest param to propagate test-fixture-ness, (3) the writer's name/owner heuristic that flags isTest doesn't catch c9iN- prefixes. Net effect: sweep fixtures from admin-wired cowork instances are visible to band members on /perform until per-id deletion.
expected: Any of: (a) clone_setlist + clone_setlist_from_template + create_template_from_setlist accept and stamp isTest:true and cleanup_all_test_data also sweeps by isTest+name-prefix; (b) extend the create_setlist writer-side heuristic to flag c9iN- and test- prefixed names as isTest; (c) tighten PARENT §6 to mandate per-id fixture tracking when admin-wired, with an explicit warning about /perform leak; (d) admin-only cleanup-by-name-prefix tool.

summary: Prod templates still not seeded (C7I1-001 unshipped) — band-onboarding blocker

summary: templateType case/separator inconsistency: prod data uses snake_case but tool examples use kebab-case
repro: Source setlist UnjLqKTtS4lNKQfMY6hB has templateType:'shabbat_morning' (snake). Tool docstrings + PARENT examples use 'shabbat-morning' (kebab). list_templates({templateType:'shabbat-morning'}) would miss prod data.
observed: Filter on templateType is exact-match; the kebab-vs-snake mismatch silently returns empty.
expected: Normalize at writer time OR make the filter case/separator-insensitive.

summary: Duplicate 'Daniel Bogard' accounts (93Xn3... + qIcEDdpHa5...) both in active band-recipient pool
repro: publish_setlist({setlistId, dryRun:true}) lists recipient qIcEDdpHa5gr3cQVcGduPWyTxvQ2 'Daniel Bogard' dsbogard@gmail.com alongside the (filtered) bearer-self 93Xn3.... suggest_band ranks BOTH uids for acoustic_guitar at score 27.

summary: trackCount drift in list_setlists confirmed in prod — 'Confirmation Shabbat' shows 0 but has 5 tracks (cycle-9 hardening B target)

summary: Setting rabbi:'Randy Fleisher' on a setlist does NOT activate rabbiGuidance in suggest_band — rabbiProfiles config likely missing entry
repro: update_setlist({id, rabbi:'Randy Fleisher'}) → ok; suggest_band(id) still returns rabbiGuidance:null with identical ranking to no-rabbi case.
observed: rabbi metadata round-trips but the rabbi-aware ranking branch doesn't fire.
expected: config/congregation.scheduling.rabbiProfiles[] should contain a 'Randy Fleisher' entry so the branch fires.

summary: Missing-chart reason text differs between the two tools
repro: verify_setlist_charts(setlist).rows[i].health.reason = 'Not in Storage; Drive 404: File not found: <id>.' vs generate_gig_packet(setlist).missingCharts[i].reason = 'Chart bytes not found in Storage or Drive (orphan library entry)'. Same underlying condition.
observed: Two operator-facing surfaces describe the same failure differently.
expected: Harmonize the strings so the operator sees the same reason text in both places.

summary: Some legacy library rows have '.pdf' embedded in title field, surfacing on /perform
repro: clone_setlist of 'Confirmation Shabbat' produced tracks with title:'Shalom alechem (Goldfarb).pdf', 'Mi chamocha (Moshav).pdf', etc.

expected: Title should be the song's display name, filename should be separate. Catalog-import code should strip extensions.

summary: recent_write sort surfaces a Feb 2026 setlist above a May 20 2026 setlist
repro: After my cleanup, list_setlists({sort:'recent_write'}) returned 'Eitan Shabbat Morning 2/21' (b12a5221-..., date:2026-02-20T19:44:46.077Z) as the FIRST result, ahead of '5/15 -- Shir Shabbat' (NWPBba50fltX6pNcyOVK, date:2026-05-20T19:53:47.014Z).

summary: 31-track clone + setlist→template→setlist round-trip preserve every field cleanly
repro: clone_setlist + get_setlist on 30-track May 2 Shabbat. Then create_template_from_setlist + get_template + clone_setlist_from_template + get_setlist on the 31-track post-tweak fixture.

summary: Publish refusal layer cake is clean: chart-health first, then publisher-self filter, with structured machine_code + hint payloads
repro: publish_setlist({recipients:[{uid:self}]}) → machine_code:'publish_refused_unhealthy_charts' with structured chartHealth + hint. publish_setlist({recipients:[{uid:self}], force:true, dryRun:true}) → bypasses chart-health, then machine_code:'no_valid_recipients'.

summary: Duplicate template names accepted (C8I1-004 confirmed)
repro: create_template_from_setlist({name:'c9i2-template-shabbat-morning-roundtrip'}) twice in a row → two different templateIds, both with the identical name.

summary: Very long template names accepted with no length cap (C8I1-005 confirmed)
repro: create_template_from_setlist({name:'c9i2-VERY-LONG-template-name-' + 'a' × ~270}) → ok:true.
observed: No max-length validation on template names. Display widgets that assume sane lengths will overflow / break layout.
expected: Enforce a max name length at the writer (e.g., 80 or 120 chars to match create_test_account's label cap).

summary: reorder_setlist requires enumerating every trackId — high-friction for routine 'move row N to position M'
repro: To move 2 rows into a different section of a 31-track setlist, the agent had to fetch get_setlist for current trackIds, manually build a 31-element ordered array, and pass it whole. Tool rejects array if any id is missing or duplicated.
observed: Composing routine moves into the bulk-reorder primitive is high cognitive cost.
expected: Add a move_track({setlistId, trackId, anchorTrackId, position:'before'|'after'}) or move_track({setlistId, trackId, newOrder:N}) for the common case. Keep reorder_setlist for the 'shuffle the whole deck' use case.

summary: clone_setlist doesn't surface inherited chart-health — source's broken bonds carry forward silently
repro: clone_setlist of May 2 Shabbat returned trackCount + version. Operator only learns 4/15 bonds are broken via a separate verify_setlist_charts call. Same applies post-publish-attempt.
observed: Source-side chart hygiene gaps are inherited by every clone without a leading signal.
expected: clone_setlist could include lightweight inheritedChartHealth:{ok,missing,unreachable} counts in the response (cheap to compute during the clone walk).
